findings.issue: Exact pins (=1.5.0 sc-observability-types) in a shared published library; same in sc-ai, sc-jev-py, and =-pinned mimalloc/tree-sitter* in sc-treesitter (lib+bin). Makes downstream resolution fragile.
findings.recommendation: Caret ranges in library crates; exact pins only for leaf binaries; or document the deliberate lockstep reason next to the dependency.

findings.issue: No readme/keywords/categories/documentation on any of the seven publishable manifests; packaged manifests show readme = false.
findings.recommendation: Per-crate README.md with readme key; up to 5 keywords and 1-2 categories; share via [workspace.package].

findings.issue: No include/exclude; [[test]] jev_cross_impl path escapes crate root and is silently dropped from the package; crate-local tests ship; no per-crate LICENSE file despite license = MIT.
findings.recommendation: Explicit include allowlist per crate (keep sc-treesitter/assets/queries/**); move or explicitly exclude the cross-impl test; add LICENSE files.

findings.issue: Two toml majors in the publish graph (sc-jev toml 1.1.8, sc-jev-check toml 0.8), declared inline; ureq and observability pins duplicated across crates.
findings.recommendation: Hoist toml, ureq, observability pins to [workspace.dependencies]; one toml major.

findings.issue: mimalloc is an unconditional dep of the library target; redundant explicit [[bin]]; lib consumers build mimalloc C code.
findings.recommendation: Gate mimalloc behind a default-on feature with required-features on the bin, or document the cost.

findings.issue: Static version duplicates workspace version (controlled by kit sync-python-version); PyPI metadata lacks readme, authors, classifiers, project.urls.
findings.recommendation: Keep static version while the sync check runs in CI; add readme/authors/urls/classifiers; confirm the dry-run workflow fails on divergence.

notes: version.workspace=true and metadata inheritance present on all 8 crates; path deps carry versions; features additive default-off; sc-jev-py publish=false correct; publish order topologically sound
Findings bucketed under RBP-003 as nearest practice id; they are publish-readiness, not code-structure
